trials.storyPrompt: Welcome to Cinder Cavern! An `if` statement lets Python make a decision—when a check is True, Python runs the indented code underneath. choices.label: Option B
choices.explanation: Spot on! It has `heat > 50:` with the colon at the end AND 4 spaces of indentation before `shout("Shield up!")`!

choices.label: Option C

choices.label: Option D
